t: Created in 1545 by Pope Paul III for his son Pier Luigi Farnese, from territory taken from the Papal States.
Its duke Alessandro Farnese was Spain’s leading general in the Netherlands, and the Farnese were major patrons of art.
Later ruled by the Bourbon-Parma line and Napoleon’s widow Marie Louise, it joined Italy in 1859–1860.
dyk: The wooden Teatro Farnese, built in 1618 inside the Pilotta palace, staged its first spectacle only in 1628 and was used for just a few court festivities before falling out of use.
ev: Pope Paul III creates the duchy for his son Pier Luigi Farnese
Pier Luigi Farnese is murdered in Piacenza
Alessandro Farnese captures Antwerp for Spain
The Teatro Farnese is built in the Pilotta palace
The Farnese line dies out; Charles of Bourbon inherits
Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle founds the Bourbon-Parma line
Marie Louise, Napoleon’s wife, receives the duchy
A plebiscite approves annexation to the Kingdom of Sardinia

f.successor: United Provinces of Central Italy; Kingdom of Sardinia
